request.question:
What would be affected if resolve_semantic_fks changed? List every function that calls it directly or indirectly, with the shortest call depth, outside the tests.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
Return every requested field using exactly its specified column alias. Preserve complete case-sensitive repository-relative paths and symbol IDs; do not substitute display names. Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text.

Calls include callback references (call_kind 'callback'), where a function is passed to another call such as asyncio.to_thread(f, x). Overridden methods called through a base class (self._run_once() in a base class) are not followed to the subclass.

gold_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY i.symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id;
agent_sql: WITH RECURSIVE call_graph AS (SELECT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id, 1 AS depth, ARRAY[c.callee_symbol_id, c.caller_symbol_id] AS path FROM code.calls AS c JOIN code.symbols AS cs ON cs.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id WHERE cs.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks' UNION ALL SELECT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id, cg.depth + 1 AS depth, array_append(cg.path, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM code.calls AS c JOIN call_graph AS cg ON c.callee_symbol_id = cg.symbol_id WHERE NOT list_contains(cg.path, c.caller_symbol_id)), shortest AS (SELECT cg.symbol_id AS symbol_id, MIN(cg.depth) AS depth FROM call_graph AS cg GROUP BY cg.symbol_id) SELECT s.symbol_id AS symbol_id, sh.depth AS depth FROM shortest AS sh JOIN code.symbols AS s ON s.symbol_id = sh.symbol_id WHERE s.kind = 'function' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.test_links AS t WHERE t.test_file_id = s.file_id) ORDER BY sh.depth, s.symbol_id
agent_answer: This walks the call graph backwards from the function named resolve_semantic_fks: it starts with every call record whose resolved target is a symbol with that name, then recursively finds callers of those callers, so direct callers get depth 1 and each further hop adds one. Callback references are counted exactly like direct calls, and only the minimum hop count is kept when a function can be reached by several paths. Finally, the symbol catalogue is joined in to keep just functions that are not located in test files, and the output lists the symbol ID with its shortest call depth, ordered by depth and then symbol ID.
